title: HubSpot Follow-up Email Decline via Audio Upload
breadth_reason: This script extends Anticipy's breadth by handling audio-uploaded follow-up requests that require HubSpot surface verification, a common real-world CRM workflow.

v7_target.surface_rule: User must be signed into HubSpot in Chrome with a contact record visible
v7_target.proof_rule: Proof requires a screenshot of the HubSpot contact record page with the email field visible, captured by the Anticipy engine from the user's actual Chrome profile

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage is required to capture the exact spoken instruction for HubSpot follow-up; other input modes would bypass the audio verification path.

real_user_surfaces.name: HubSpot Contact Record
real_user_surfaces.surface: HubSpot contact record page in signed-in Chrome
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Screenshot showing contact record with email field visible

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Browser
real_user_surfaces.surface: User's Chrome profile with HubSpot session
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Screenshot of Chrome window with HubSpot tab active and signed-in indicator

moments.description: User navigates to Anticipy public app and completes onboarding to download engine.
Driver checks that user is signed into HubSpot in Chrome and has a contact record visible.

moments.spoken_reference_text: After the partner sync with Daria, please add a follow-up note in HubSpot for the Jordan account saying I promised to send the renewal terms and ask if Friday morning works for a follow-up call. If you cannot prove the visible HubSpot record or my signed-in surface, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger must say the spoken_reference_text aloud and record as MP3 audio file, then upload via /api/listen/upload endpoint. The Anticipy engine will transcribe via ASR.

moments.description: Engine checks that the transcribed text matches the expected follow-up request and that the HubSpot surface is still accessible.

acceptable_outcomes.act: Engine drafts email in HubSpot and sends it, with proof of HubSpot record and sent email.
acceptable_outcomes.ask: Engine asks user to confirm the follow-up details before sending, with proof of HubSpot record.
acceptable_outcomes.decline: Engine declines to act because HubSpot surface is not verified, with explanation and no email drafted.

moments.description: Driver observes that the script only works with audio upload; other input modes are not supported for this decline scenario.

success_criteria: The user uploads an MP3 audio file containing the spoken follow-up instruction.
The Anticipy engine transcribes the audio and identifies the intent to draft an email in HubSpot.
The engine checks the user's signed-in HubSpot surface and finds it unverified.
The engine declines to act, providing a clear explanation.
The entire flow uses the public product path and produces proof of the surface check.
failure_triggers: The audio file is not uploaded or is corrupted.
The ASR fails to transcribe the instruction correctly.
The HubSpot surface is not visible or the user is not signed in.
The engine attempts to act without proper proof.
The user's Chrome profile is not the actual signed-in profile.
